description:
Macklin Celebrini delivered a sensational sophomore season, establishing himself as a budding superstar. He became just the sixth player in NHL history to reach 100 points as a teenager and was electric every time he touched the puck. Finishing fourth overall in league scoring, Celebrini tallied 45 goals and 70 assists for 115 points, outpacing his next closest Sharks teammate by a staggering 56 points.  
One of his standout moments came against in-state rival Los Angeles. With the Sharks trailing late and their goalie pulled for the extra attacker, Celebrini danced through two Kings defenders with dazzling skill before firing home the game-tying goal.  
Against Dallas, he showcased his elite playmaking ability. Off an offensive zone faceoff, Celebrini used a clever trick move to push the puck forward and catch the Stars off guard. Maintaining control, he waited patiently until a seam opened cross-ice, then delivered a perfect pass to a wide-open Collin Graf in front for the Sharks goal.  
Finally, against Calgary, Celebrini scored an incredible spin-o-rama goal — the eventual game-winner — that left Sharks fans in awe of his creativity and skill.
